import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
plt.plot(df['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)'], df['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).10'], marker='o')
plt.title('Trend of Final Deprivation Rank across Unitary Authorities')
plt.xlabel('Unitary Authority')
plt.ylabel('Final Deprivation Rank')
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)', 'y_fields': ['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).10'], 'chart_type': 'lineChart'}
plt.show()
